title: ExecRequest
description: Request body for executing a DDL or DML SQL statement that does not return a result set.

sql.description: The SQL statement to execute. Supports all DDL and DML statement types including CREATE, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and DROP.

database.description: Name of the database to use when executing the statement. If not provided, the default database for the authenticated user is used.

args.description: Positional arguments for parameterized SQL statements. Use ? placeholders in the sql field and provide values in order here.
